# Parasoft — DO-178C Software Compliance for Aerospace & Defense (vendor ebook)

> **External, not NASA governance.** Useful for comparison and vocabulary. It never establishes
> what NASA requires, and must not be cited as NASA coverage.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Publisher / owner** | Parasoft (software testing vendor) |
| **Kind** | Vendor marketing material (ebook). Not the RTCA standard |
| **Status** | Landing page and a preview are public. Full text not publicly available without a form: the landing page says "To download the full ebook please provide your business email" (landing page). That is a marketing form, not a login. The full ebook was not read |
| **Where to get it** | `https://www.parasoft.com/ebook/do-178c-software-compliance-for-aerospace-defense` (landing page confirmed anonymously off-network, 2026-10-26) |
| **Binds whom** | No one |

**Pointer only.** The landing page describes the ebook as: "Learn about the important role that the strict functional safety standard, DO-178C, plays in the production of software for airborne systems and equipment" (landing page). No content claims are made here beyond that page. For the standard itself see `RTCA_DO-178C.md`.
